chapters.summary: Peter writes to the scattered believers, praising God for the living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ and for an inheritance incorruptible, reserved in heaven. He urges them to rejoice even in trials that prove their faith, to be holy in all conduct, and reminds them that they were redeemed not with corruptible things like silver and gold but with the precious blood of Christ.

chapters.summary: Peter instructs believers to desire the sincere milk of the word and describes them as living stones built up into a spiritual house, a holy priesthood. chapters.summary: Peter urges believers to arm themselves with the mind of Christ, to cease from sin, and not to think it strange when the fiery trial comes as though something unusual were happening. He teaches that judgment must begin at the house of God, and that those who suffer according to the will of God should commit the keeping of their souls to Him in well doing as unto a faithful Creator.

verses.kjv: Greet ye one another with a kiss of charity. Peace be with you all that are in Christ Jesus. Amen.
verses.modern: Greet one another with a kiss of charity. Peace be with You all who are in Christ Jesus. Amen.

chapters.summary: Peter exhorts the elders to feed the flock of God willingly, not for dishonest gain, and as examples rather than as lords over those in their charge. He commands all believers to be clothed with humility, to cast all their care on God for He cares for them, and to be sober and vigilant because the devil walks about as a roaring lion seeking whom he may devour.
